_comment: CI's floor for the evaluation replay (quality.yml): the committed replies replay deterministically, so these are today's numbers and any change to the shared post-processing that reads them worse fails. Raise them when a change reads better; lower one only with the reason in the pull request. Units match exactly after clinical normalisation since 2026-11-09 (a cut-off unit no longer counts), which read LDL's 'mg/dL (calc)' as wrong until the shared post-processing dropped printed notes from units (2026-11-09): 76 values, 62 LOINC, 1 extra number, no wrong value unflagged. Two reports joined on 2026-11-09 for the row layouts the unit check must not mistake (en_cumulative_flags: a previous-result column behind a written-out flag, two tests a line with the unit in each label; de_einheit_vorn: the unit column first): 96 values, 81 LOINC, 9 dates; extra numbers went from 1 to 2 because the model read en_cumulative_flags' WBC 11.8 as 111.8, which the source check flags. The planted* numbers are the errors planted in the right readings (evaluation/.../PlantedErrors.kt): the set mustn't shrink, and no more may slip through, in total and of each kind (plantedByKind: planted at least, notFlagged = planted - flagged at most), so one kind reading worse can't hide behind another reading better. Twelve reports joined on 2026-11-09 (en_gb_bloods, en_us_wellness, en_us_summit, en_us_metabolic, en_au_pathology, de_praxis, fr_labo, es_hospital, it_lab, nl_uitslag, pt_analises, sv_provsvar) so that a dropped '<'/'>' and a day-and-month swap are planted at least 10 times each, with the Review check flagging a dropped qualifier by the row's own result and a date whose day and month read either way: 159 values, 115 LOINC, 49 text results, 18 dates; extra numbers went from 2 to 3 because the model read en_us_wellness' HDL 44 as 444, which the source check flags (a reply misread, not post-processing reading worse). Text results now count only where they are the printed one (en_us_wellness' Vitamin D '>150' read as '>1500' is wrong, and flagged); a read date that is wrong but flagged for the user to check is no silent wrong date (en_us_wellness' 2026-04-11 for 11/04/2026, nl_uitslag's birth date). So that flagging every date can't pass for catching it, the dates flagged are bounded too (datesFlagged: those two; rightDatesFlagged: none), each report's right date is a control (plantedDateControls, plantedDateFalseFlags: en_us_wellness's 11/04/2026 reads either way and nothing in the report says which, so its right date is flagged, which is the one allowed), and a planted date counts as caught by its flag only where the right date isn't flagged. The replay reads on a fixed day (EVALUATION_DAY, 2026-11-09), since a reading after it is no report date. On 2026-11-10 the Review check began judging a result by its test's own part of a line (from its name up to the next test's), so a neighbour's value on the same line (de_patmed's six) and the 12 of "Vitamin B12" read for 512 are caught: 1006 of 1007 flagged; the one left is en_serology's Ferritin with the ANA flag "A" as its unit, which post-processing drops as a flag, leaving a value without a unit, which the check deliberately claims nothing about.
